full_name: Michelle Karnes | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Humanities Walter Jackson Bate Fellow University of Notre Dame
bio: Michelle Karnes is an associate professor in the English department at Notre Dame. She works on late medieval literature and philosophy and is now studying the role of marvels in both.
